name: Hominini
blurb: Humans, chimpanzees and bonobos. Chimpanzees and bonobos are our closest living relatives.

fossilMin.taxon: Sahelanthropus tchadensis (skull TM 266-01-060-1), a basal hominin
fossilMin.dating: Biostratigraphy, correlated with the lower Nawata Formation at Lothagam (7.4–6.5 Ma)
fossilMin.checked: Benton et al. 2015, full text (palaeo-electronica.org/content/pdfs/424.pdf), node 87 (Chimpanzee–Human)

softMax.basis: Late Miocene apes (Ankarapithecus, Lufengopithecus, Ouranopithecus, Sivapithecus) but no chimpanzee or human relatives in deposits about 10 Ma old
softMax.checked: Benton et al. 2015, full text (palaeo-electronica.org/content/pdfs/424.pdf), node 87 (Chimpanzee–Human)

clock.method: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock (MCMCTree), posterior mean and 95% HPD
clock.note: A phylogenomic node age: it dates the divergence of sequences, which precedes the split of the populations (here constrained by the 6.5–10 Ma fossil calibration).
